title: CHIBA-ICHIHARA-CULTURE-MAIN BOUNDED PRODUCTION IMPLEMENTATION
scope: 市原市市民会館〔大ホール〕 (inventory chiba-ichihara-culture-main) only. 美喜仁桐生文化会館, RaiBoC Hall, the remaining Kanto research pool and Tokyo Priority D were explicitly out of scope and were not opened.

startSnapshot.note: Verified against the repository itself, not against notes. chiba-ichihara-culture-main and gunma-kiryu-culture-main were the two open ADOPTs; kanagawa-kaat-hall was already PRODUCTION; saitama-raiboc-main remained blocked in its separate transcription-remediation queue and was not touched.

policyConsistencyCleanup.problem: The 2026-09-01 section 転記のcross-check必須要件（production共通） made a fresh independent human visual two-pass, issuer subtotal reconciliation and an independent machine structural checksum mandatory, but two older passages still said the opposite: the production hard-gate paragraph listed 独立2 generation among the items that are 'confidence information, not a hard gate', and the workflow section stated flatly that 独立generation不足 is not a production blocker. The status list carried the same 独立2 generation wording.
changes: 転記のcross-check必須要件（production共通） now opens by declaring itself the current authoring/review contract and states that it applies as a mandatory requirement to new production implementations and to re-implementations of blocked venues from 2026-09-01 onward, and that it does not retroactively invalidate historical production.

The production hard-gate paragraph no longer lists 独立2 generation as mere confidence information. It now states that transcription verification is excluded from that list and that, for configurations promoted to production from 2026-09-01 onward and for re-implementations out of blocked, each item of the cross-check section applies as a hard gate (human visual two-pass for ordinary venues, the defined DENSE-VECTOR verification for DENSE-VECTOR eligible charts, issuer subtotal reconciliation, an independent structural checksum where a machine structural count is practical, and production stop on material mismatch).
The status list entry for `production` drops 独立2 generation and points at the cross-check section as the current rule for 2026-09-01 onward.

The workflow sentence 独立generation不足はproduction blockerではありません is retained only as an explicitly labelled legacy / backward-compatibility statement about pre-2026-09-01 historical production, with its purpose stated: it exists so historical production is not demoted or re-audited en masse merely because it lacks today's machine-readable report or two-pass metadata. It is explicitly marked as not the current implementation rule, and a following paragraph states that new implementations and blocked-venue re-implementations use the cross-check section instead.
notDone: No re-verification or demotion of any of the 140 pre-existing production venues.
No threshold change and no unrelated refactor.
policyConsistencyCleanup.validation: npm run verify:docs passed (local Markdown links across 24 files, shared agent instruction and venue-wave adapter contracts, verify:harness including the SessionStart, hook, permission and subagent-role checks, and git diff --check).

configurationGate.rowLabels: Red arabic numerals 1–32, defined on the chart itself by 「赤い数字は、客席の列番号です。」 Each row's seat numbers run continuously left to right across the aisles within that row, so a row number plus a seat number is unique house-wide.

The downloads index publishes only technical drawings (舞台平面図, 照明基本仕込み図, DMX回路表, SUS/PBL回路配列図, 照明機材表, 音響舞台客席図面, 音響機材リスト, 楽屋図, 駐車場配置図) and no second numbered audience configuration.

configurationGate.orchestraPitOrStageRelatedSeatChange: None disclosed. The stage equipment list is 大迫り・小迫り・音響反射板・緞帳（第1・第2）・バトン9本・松羽目; no orchestra pit and no stage extension that removes rows is published.

configurationGate.decision: One issuer-defined standard configuration. No alternative configuration was found in current issuer material, so nothing was mixed in and nothing was excluded by inference.

targetDiscipline.rule: 1,527 was not used as a mapped target and 1,523 (= 1,527 − 4) was never adopted as an expected value.
targetDiscipline.practice: The printed identifier set was established first, independently, from the chart alone by two human passes and three machine paths. Only afterwards was it compared with the issuer's published figures. No range was created, extended, shortened or deleted to reach any total.

passA.label: Human visual Pass 1
passA.order: row-major, rows 1 → 32; within each row left block → right block; within each range low number first.
passA.rendering: Rendered from the PDF at dpi 150 (overview) and dpi 340/400/500/700/800/900 for per-region reads. The right-hand wing prints its seat numbers rotated a uniform +18.55°, so it was re-rendered de-skewed by −18.55° to bring the digits upright before reading.
passA.recorded: floor/area, row, every printed seat ID, contiguous ranges, split ranges, explicit gaps, side/wing areas, wheelchair pictograms, unnumbered positions, special markings, removable/technical annotations.

passB.label: Human visual Pass 2
passB.assetReacquired: The PDF was re-fetched independently (map3.pdf) before Pass 2; same SHA-256.
passB.order: column-major instead of row-major — a different acquisition path, not a re-walk of the Pass 1 table. Blocks were read one whole column-block at a time; rows bottom-to-top (32 → 18, then 17 → 1); blocks right-to-left; ranges high number first.
passB.rendering: Different crop boundaries and different resolutions from Pass 1: dpi 260/380/400/430/460/560/620, with the right wing and rear wing de-skewed from different clip rectangles.

humanComparison.method: Both passes were frozen to JSON, then expanded to (row, seat) key sets and compared programmatically.
humanComparison.note: Human-human MATCH was treated as necessary but not sufficient; the machine checksums below were taken before the production decision.

machineStructuralChecksum.feasibility: PREFLIGHT 3 recorded machineStructuralCountFeasibility: possible. Confirmed: the chart draws every seat as a discrete stroked quad and prints its number as vector text inside it.
machineStructuralChecksum.independence: None of the three paths reads the human range tables. Each derives its own segmentation from the drawing.

pathA.name: PDF vector seat-cell geometry
pathA.method: Every stroked quad in the page content stream was measured (side lengths, centre, rotation) and filtered to seat-cell dimensions. No text was read.
pathA.result: 1,531 seat-cell-sized quads: 1,527 numbered cells (8.17–8.18 × 8.15–8.16 pt, plus 50 marginally taller 8.59/8.67 pt cells inside the rotated wings) and 4 wheelchair pictogram squares (7.94 × 7.94 pt). Separately, 4 double-width wheelchair cell outlines (8.18 × 16.4 pt) were found at the same four positions. Numbered seat cells = 1,527.
pathA.orientationSplit: 1,046 axis-aligned cells and 485 cells rotated +18.55°; two orientations only, no per-row fan variation.

pathB.name: Band-clustered identifier reconstruction
pathB.method: The same vector cells were clustered geometrically into bands (axis-aligned group and +18.55° rotated group, each projected onto its own perpendicular axis). Each band was then assigned a row number from the red row-label text spans by proximity, and each cell's printed identifier was reconstructed by assigning digit glyphs to cells by containment and ordering them along the cell's own text direction.
pathB.result: 32 axis-aligned bands and 27 rotated bands; 1,527 cells, every one containing at least one digit glyph and no digit glyph left unassigned. The reconstructed (row, seat) identifier set has 1,527 members and is set-equal to the human two-pass set with zero difference in either direction.

pathC.name: 600 dpi raster contour hierarchy
pathC.method: The page was rasterised at 600 dpi from the independently re-fetched asset, thresholded to an ink mask, and analysed with a contour tree. Enclosed regions at seat-cell dimensions were counted, split by whether they contain an inner ink island (a printed glyph). This path never touches the PDF object model.
pathC.result: 1,527 seat-cell-sized enclosed regions containing a printed glyph.
pathC.falsePositivesResolved: 12 further seat-cell-sized empty regions were returned and were classified back against the chart: two are the white gaps inside the row-17 left wheelchair cells beside the pictogram squares, six are stair-tread and wall-corner gaps on the right-hand side, and four are wall/hatching artefacts near the stage and the entrances. None is a seat, and none carries a printed number.
pathC.limitation: The raster path cannot separate the wheelchair pictogram squares from the cell strokes they touch, so the wheelchair count is taken from path A and from both human passes, not from the raster.

redRowLabelChecksum.method: The count and multiplicity of red row-number text spans was tallied independently of the human passes.
redRowLabelChecksum.result: 108 red row labels: rows 1–3 twice each, row 4 once, rows 5–17 three times each, rows 18–23 five times each, rows 24–28 four times each, rows 29–32 three times each.
redRowLabelChecksum.significance: The multiplicity is exactly the number of aisle gaps each row has, so it independently reproduces the block topology, and the single occurrence of '4' independently confirms that row 4 has no right-wing block and no right-wing row label.

newSubtotalFoundInFreshMaterial.document: ホール利用案内（2026.7改訂版） PDF, created 2026-07-06, 20 pages, SHA-256 e98ecae5bc1d1f91cff29f975202d20d6857a912006952cce6469f8d816bb07f
newSubtotalFoundInFreshMaterial.content: 大ホール: 固定席 1,527席 / 車いす席 4席 — listed as two separate line items. (小ホール is given the same way: 固定席 491席 / 車いす席 2席.)
newSubtotalFoundInFreshMaterial.significance: This is a decomposition PREFLIGHT 3 did not have. It resolves the 1527席（車イス4席） ambiguity from the issuer's own current material: 1,527 is the 固定席 subtotal and the 4 wheelchair spaces are a separate line, not an inclusive breakdown.

issuerChecksumEvidence.noFloorOrAreaSubtotal: The issuer publishes no per-floor or per-area subtotal. The hall is a single floor and the only published subtotals are 固定席 1,527 and 車いす席 4.

reconciliation.isWheelchair4IncludedIn1527: No. The current 2026-07 official hall guide lists 固定席 1,527席 and 車いす席 4席 as separate line items, and the mapped printed numbered set is exactly 1,527, so the four wheelchair spaces sit outside the 1,527 rather than inside it. This is read off issuer evidence plus the drawing, not assumed.
reconciliation.areTheWheelchairPositionsNumbered: No. All four are drawn as double-width cells (8.18 × 16.4 pt) containing a wheelchair pictogram and carrying no printed number.
reconciliation.issuerDefinedReplacementRelation: None published. The issuer nowhere states which seat numbers the four spaces replace. Row 17 simply prints 5–51, so numbers 1–4 and 52–55 are absent from that row on the drawing; no adjacent number was deleted by inference and no wheelchair seat ID was invented.
reconciliation.machineSeatCellAgreement: Exact at grand total, at per-band level for all 59 bands, and at full identifier-set level.
reconciliation.otherUnnumberedPositions: None. Every one of the 1,527 seat cells contains a printed number, and the only unnumbered drawn positions in the audience area are the four wheelchair cells.
reconciliation.completeAsStandardConfiguration: Yes. Rows 1–32 are fully transcribed with no unresolved ownership and no configuration mixing.

difference against the official total is 0 and is further explained by the issuer's own 固定席 / 車いす席 decomposition

semantics.wheelchair: Four unnumbered double-width pictogram cells in row 17 — two at the left end (where 1–4 would be) and two at the right end (where 52–55 would be). Outside the issuer's 固定席 1,527. Not registered, not drawable.
semantics.rowFourRightWing: Row 4 has no right-wing block on the drawing and no right-wing red row label; the wing's label sequence is 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 … 17. Registered as printed (8–31 only); nothing was interpolated.
semantics.standing: No standing area is drawn or published.
semantics.restrictedViewOrPa: No such marking exists on this chart.
semantics.areaOwnership: Single floor, single area. Seat numbers run continuously across aisles within each row, so no repository-invented block names were needed and none were created.

initialBuild.failureReason: The Cloudflare log shows only `Initializing build environment...` followed about five minutes later by `Build failed to initialize and was timed out`. The Cloning, Installing, Building and Deploying stages were never reached.
initialBuild.notACodeOrBuildCommandFailure: Independently corroborated before the retry: a throwaway clean clone of this exact commit, checked out with core.autocrlf=false so the working tree byte-matches a Linux runner, ran `npm ci` (284 packages, exit 0) and then Cloudflare's own build command `npm run build` (exit 0; venues:check byte-identical, venues:validate 141 / 143 / 210,466 with the known 45 warnings). The produced dist differed from the last successfully deployed commit f145e12 by exactly one added asset (dist/venue-db/venues/ichihara-civic-large-hall--standard.json), 152 -> 153 files and 2,870,821 -> 2,877,628 bytes, far under the Workers Static Assets limits.
initialBuild.outcome: Nothing was deployed; the public site continued to serve the previous version.

retry.trigger: The user manually retried the same production commit from the Cloudflare Dashboard. No new commit, no code change, no dependency change and no empty/no-op commit was pushed.
retry.conclusion: The identical commit deployed cleanly with no change of any kind, which confirms the initial failure was a transient Cloudflare build-environment initialization timeout and not a defect in this repository.
retry.githubCheckRunNote: The dashboard retry did not publish a second check run to GitHub; the commit still shows only the original failed check run. The deployment was therefore verified directly against the live site rather than from the GitHub check status.
retry.noRemediationRequired: The npm audit vulnerability count and the allow-scripts warning visible in the Cloudflare log did not block the build or the deploy and are explicitly out of scope for this wave. No `npm audit fix`, dependency upgrade or package change was made.
